agent_notes: 'In the last days' (49:1) is a prophetic horizon, not a date. Ramban and Sforno read it as the days of the Messiah; I have not turned it into a time offset.

Jacob's oracles about Simeon and Levi (49:7), Judah (49:10) and the others are prophecies; they are fulfilled in later books (tribal allotments, Joshua and following), not in Genesis, so no FULFILLS_PROPHECY link is written here. Gen 48:21 ('God will bring you back') and the burial charge are fulfilled in Gen 50, whose session should link them to this chapter's burial_charge.
